mapper.select:
select compo_id compoId, compo_name compoName, compo_path compoPath from sys_compo_config where compo_id in
#{id}

select rel.industry_code industryCode, rel.app_ver_code appVerCode, rel.industry_view_type viewType, rel.`sort`, conf.`id` industryViewId, rel.`view_name` industryViewName, rel.display_type displayType, 0 industryViewType from sys_industry_view_rel rel inner join `sys_industry_view` conf on rel.`industry_view_id` = conf.`id` and rel.industry_view_type = 1 where rel.industry_code = #{param.industryCode} and rel.app_ver_code = #{param.appVerCode} and conf.`delete_flag` = 0 order by rel.`sort`, rel.id

select rel.industry_code industryCode, rel.app_ver_code appVerCode, rel.industry_view_type viewType, rel.`sort`, conf.`id` industryViewId, rel.`view_name` industryViewName, rel.display_type displayType, 0 industryViewType from sys_industry_view_rel rel inner join `sys_industry_screen` conf on rel.`industry_view_id` = conf.`id` and rel.industry_view_type = 2 where rel.industry_code = #{param.industryCode} and rel.app_ver_code = #{param.appVerCode} and conf.`delete_flag` = 0 order by rel.`sort`, rel.id

select rel.tenant_id tenantId, rel.industry_code industryCode, rel.app_ver_code appVerCode, conf.`id` industryViewId, rel.screen_alias industryViewName, 0 displayType, 1 industryViewType from `sys_third_party_screen_tenant_rel` rel inner join `sys_third_party_screen_conf` conf on rel.`third_party_screen_id` = conf.`id` where rel.tenant_id = #{param.tenantId} and rel.industry_code = #{param.industryCode} and rel.app_ver_code = #{param.appVerCode} and conf.`delete_flag` = 0 order by conf.create_time, conf.id

select conf.`id`, conf.screen_name, rel.screen_alias, rel.tenant_id, rel.industry_code from sys_third_party_screen_tenant_rel rel inner join `sys_third_party_screen_conf` conf on rel.`third_party_screen_id` = conf.`id` where rel.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and rel.industry_code = #{industryCode} and conf.`delete_flag` = 0 and conf.`screen_type` = 2 limit 1
